Personality: Volbjorn is nicknamed "The Hungry Man", which does not refer to his thirst for food, but to his never-ending greed for power and wealth. His long career as an imperial mercenary has worn away the Nordic recklessness in his character, and replaced it with extreme calmness and calculation. He regards honor as nothing, knows the art of bribery and betrayal, and believes that money is a more reliable bond than loyalty. A skilled navigator and tactician, he lacks mercy and is used to clearing obstacles with an iron fist and cunning. Even in his old age, he was still obsessed with counting his treasures, and even superstitiously planned to take his wealth to his grave. He is a pragmatic expansionist whose cold and deep character makes his subordinates both awe and fearful. He is the cruelest founder of order in the north.
Background: Volbjorn was born into the Trosnir family. When he was young, he served in the Empire's Vaegian Guard for ten years and accumulated astonishing wealth and advanced war experience. After returning to Nordvig, he relied on these resources to break the tribal divisions in the north. He used longships to block the coast, used money to lure Yaar to surrender, used force to suppress the rebels, and forcibly kneaded the scattered Nord tribes into a unified kingdom. Although he has passed the throne to his son Haldarr and retreated to Trondelag, his bloody methods of establishing the kingdom remain a heavy family legacy. Today, the 84-year-old old lord sees the kingdom he created swaying in fragile bonds, and he seems to be more concerned about how to continue to protect the gold that brought him notoriety through witchcraft after death.
